title: Scheme size bounded by an open covering
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $Y=\bigcup_{i\in I}Y_i$ an open covering indexed by a set $I$, with the induced open subscheme structures on the $Y_i$. For a scheme $Z$, put $s(Z)=\max\{\aleph_0,|\mathcal B(Z)|,\sup_{V\in\mathcal B(Z)}|\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_Z)|\}$, where $\mathcal B(Z)$ is the set of affine open subschemes and $\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_Z)$ is the ring of sections of the structure sheaf on $V$. Then $s(Y)\leq\max\{\aleph_0,|I|,\sup_{i\in I}s(Y_i)\}$. The empty covering is allowed, in which case $Y$ is empty.

source.place: Tag 000Q, lemma-bound-size (with an explicit aleph_0 term to include the empty covering); scheme size defined in section-categories-schemes preceding Tag 000I.

proof.text: Put $\kappa=\max\{\aleph_0,|I|,\sup_i s(Y_i)\}$ and choose a set $K$ of cardinality $\kappa$. The inline invariant agrees with [def-sfb-scheme-cardinal-size]. Thus $\kappa$ is infinite, $|I|\leq\kappa$, and for every $i$ both $|\mathcal B(Y_i)|\leq\kappa$ and $|\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_{Y_i})|\leq\kappa$ for every affine open $V\subseteq Y_i$. These are just the defining maximum and supremum inequalities.

source.place: Tag 000Q, lemma-bound-size, proof; cardinal size in section-categories-schemes (Tag 000H).

proof.text: For any affine open $U\subseteq Y$, affine quasi-compactness in [lem-weil-pbc-affine-scheme-qcqs] makes its underlying space quasi-compact. For every $x\in U$, choose $i$ with $x\in Y_i$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis] to the open $U\cap Y_i$ in $Y$ to obtain an affine open $V$ with $x\in V\subseteq U\cap Y_i$. These $V$ cover $U$, so quasi-compactness gives finitely many $V_1,\ldots,V_n$ covering $U$, with labels $i_1,\ldots,i_n$ and $V_r\subseteq Y_{i_r}$. Their induced open subscheme structures are the restrictions of the same structure sheaf, hence each $V_r$ is also an affine open of $Y_{i_r}$. For $U=\varnothing$, take $n=0$. No intersection of affine opens is asserted to be affine.

source.place: Tag 000Q, lemma-bound-size, proof; cardinal size in section-categories-schemes (Tag 000H).

proof.text: Let $A=\coprod_{i\in I}\mathcal B(Y_i)$, viewed as labelled affine opens of $Y$. Choose injections $j:I\hookrightarrow K$ and $e_i:\mathcal B(Y_i)\hookrightarrow K$, possible by step 1. The map $(i,V)\mapsto[j(i),e_i(V)]$ injects $A$ into $\operatorname{List}(K)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-list-cardinality], $|\operatorname{List}(K)|\leq\max(\aleph_0,\kappa)=\kappa$, whence $|A|\leq\kappa$. Apply that same node again to get $|\operatorname{List}(A)|\leq\kappa$. This also covers $I=\varnothing$.

source.place: Tag 000Q, lemma-bound-size, proof; cardinal size in section-categories-schemes (Tag 000H).

proof.text: Take the subset $L\subseteq\operatorname{List}(A)$ of lists whose underlying union in $Y$ is affine. Sending a list to this union gives a surjection $L\twoheadrightarrow\mathcal B(Y)$: step 2 supplies such a finite list for each affine $U$, and the empty list represents the empty affine open. Equivalently choose one representing list for each $U$; different $U$ have different unions, so this choice is injective. Therefore $|\mathcal B(Y)|\leq|\operatorname{List}(A)|\leq\kappa$ by step 3.

source.place: Tag 000Q, lemma-bound-size, proof; cardinal size in section-categories-schemes (Tag 000H).

proof.text: For the cover $U=\bigcup_{r=1}^nV_r$ from step 2, the restriction map $\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_Y)\to\prod_{r=1}^n\Gamma(V_r,\mathcal O_Y)$ is injective: sections with equal restrictions on all the members of this open cover are equal by the uniqueness axiom for the structure sheaf. The structure sheaf is a sheaf of rings because a scheme is locally ringed, as in [def-pc-scheme] and [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism]. Restriction to an open subscheme gives $\Gamma(V_r,\mathcal O_Y)=\Gamma(V_r,\mathcal O_{Y_{i_r}})$, so each factor has cardinality at most $\kappa$ by step 1. This argument also handles the empty cover: the sheaf uniqueness axiom says there is at most one section on the empty open.

source.place: Tag 000Q, lemma-bound-size, proof; cardinal size in section-categories-schemes (Tag 000H).

proof.text: For each $r$ choose an injection of the $r$-th section ring in step 5 into $K$. A tuple of sections maps injectively to the ordered list of its images in $K$; when $n=0$, the sole tuple maps to the empty list. By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-list-cardinality] this product has cardinality at most $\max(\aleph_0,|K|)=\kappa$. The injection of step 5 proves $|\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_Y)|\leq\kappa$ for every affine open $U$. Taking the supremum over these $U$, combining with step 4 and $\aleph_0\leq\kappa$, gives $s(Y)\leq\kappa$. If $I$ is empty, the covering condition forces $Y=\varnothing$ and the same argument gives $s(Y)=\aleph_0$.

Source checks: Stacks sets.tex 000H (l.311-326) defines size = max(aleph0, #affines, sup|Gamma|), which matches the inline s(Z) and def-sfb-scheme-cardinal-size exactly. Stacks 000Q (l.524-560) has the proof, and the steps follow it. The statement adds aleph0 on the right; this is correct because the empty cover gives s(empty)=aleph0 while Stacks' right side is 0, and it changes nothing when I is nonempty. Step 2 applies quasi-compactness only to an affine U. It applies the affine basis to U∩Y_i inside Y, and each V is affine in Y_i through the restricted sheaf, so no affineness of intersections is used (no E1). Steps 3 and 6 replace the Jech/Kunen cardinal arithmetic with explicit injections into List(K). They cite the Mathlib leaf Cardinal.mk_list_le_max (Arithmetic.lean:746-750, read), which has no nonemptiness hypothesis. Step 4 uses the surjection L -> B(Y) given by unions. Step 5 gets injectivity into the product from the sheaf locality axiom, with the sheaf-of-rings fact taken from def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism. proof_deps equals the union of uses, there is no cycle, all cited nodes are Mathlib leaves or definitions (no route issue, no tool_uses), and no SGA source is cited. Small cases checked: empty cover, singleton cover, finite rings, infinite repeated cover, non-quasi-separated ambient scheme. Advisory for the maintainer: the existing unsplit node lem-sfb-scheme-size-open-cover-bound (Q77, same day, cited by lem-sfb-big-site-open-cover-size-closure) duplicates this item and should be merged into it. That duplicate predates this delivery and is not its fault.

lean.statement:
theorem cardinalSize_le_openCover (X : Scheme.{u}) {I : Type v} (U : I → X.Opens)
    (hU : (⨆ i : I, U i) = ⊤) :
    Cardinal.lift.{v} X.cardinalSize ≤
      max Cardinal.aleph0
        (max (Cardinal.lift.{u} (Cardinal.mk I))
          (⨆ i : I, Cardinal.lift.{v} (U i).toScheme.cardinalSize))
lean.note: Exact existing statement of lem-sfb-scheme-size-open-cover-bound: arbitrary open covering, induced open subschemes, the same cardinalSize invariant and explicit aleph0 term, including empty covers. No new module or definition.
